rule: Multi-page pairing: Next page is primary; Save progress is secondary.

overview: On multi-page forms, Next page is primary; Save progress is secondary.

not_when: Single-page forms without a Next/Save progress pair.
agent_hint: Style Next page primary and Save progress secondary on multi-page forms.
